stories.title: Les Pyrénées-Orientales placées en vigilance orange "pluie-inondation" dimanche

en.title: Pyrénées-Orientales placed on orange alert for rain and flooding Sunday
en.summary: Pyrénées-Orientales has been placed on orange alert for rain and flooding on Sunday. Hérault and Aude were downgraded from orange to yellow alert on Saturday.

stories.title: Pluies et inondations : les Pyrénées-Orientales en vigilance orange dimanche, l’Hérault repasse au jaune

en.title: Rain and flooding: Pyrénées-Orientales on orange alert Sunday, Hérault returns to yellow
en.summary: Departments face significant rainfall this weekend, three days after a major weather event. Alert levels have been adjusted across the affected regions.

stories.title: Les Pyrénées-Orientales en vigilance orange pluie et inondations dimanche

en.title: Pyrénées-Orientales on orange alert for rain and flooding Sunday
en.summary: Pyrénées-Orientales faces orange alert for rain and flooding on Sunday. Hérault and Aude departments were downgraded from orange to yellow alert on Saturday afternoon.

stories.title: A Madrid, une manifestation pour le droit au logement rassemble entre 70 000 et 500 000 personnes

en.title: In Madrid, a demonstration for the right to housing brings together between 70,000 and 500,000 people
en.summary: A housing rights demonstration took place in Madrid on Friday. The event was prompted by government rejection of bills that would have suspended evictions for vulnerable people through 2030.

stories.title: Droit au logement en Espagne : des manifestations monstres dans tout le pays ce samedi

en.title: Right to housing in Spain: massive demonstrations across the country this Saturday
en.summary: Tens of thousands of people marched in Madrid and other Spanish cities following parliament's rejection of housing protection measures proposed by Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's government.

stories.title: En Espagne, d’immenses manifestations pour le droit au logement à Madrid et dans de nombreuses villes

en.title: In Spain, massive demonstrations for the right to housing in Madrid and many cities
en.summary: A social movement emerged after an 87-year-old Madrid resident was evicted, becoming a symbol of Spain's worsening housing crisis over recent years.

stories.title: Nouvelles manifestations pour le droit au logement prévues samedi en Espagne

en.title: New demonstrations for the right to housing planned Saturday in Spain
en.summary: Further housing rights protests are scheduled for October 3 in Madrid and other Spanish cities after lawmakers rejected tenant protection bills from Socialist Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez's government.

stories.title: Vol flydubai : l'enquête établit que le copilote planifiait un "acte terroriste"

en.title: Flydubai flight: investigation establishes that copilot was planning a "terrorist act"
en.summary: An investigation into an attack on a Flydubai flight determined the copilot used the cockpit emergency axe to attack the pilot in what authorities characterized as a terrorist act.

stories.title: Le copilote du vol Flydubai volant vers Tel-Aviv planifiait un « acte terroriste » en le déroutant, selon l’enquête des Emirats arabes unis

en.title: Flydubai copilot flying to Tel-Aviv planned a "terrorist act" by diverting the plane, according to UAE investigation
en.summary: A UAE investigation determined that a Flydubai copilot intended to carry out a terrorist act by diverting the aircraft. It is unclear whether the copilot's background was verified when he was hired by the airline.

stories.title: 🔴 Vol Flydubai : l'enquête émiratie établit que le copilote omanais planifiait un "acte terroriste"

en.title: Flydubai flight: UAE investigation establishes that Omani copilot planned a "terrorist act"
en.summary: A UAE investigation concluded that the Omani copilot of a Flydubai flight planned a terrorist act.

stories.title: Le copilote du vol FlyDubai qui a agressé son commandant de bord planifiait un "acte terroriste", affirme le procureur général des Emirats arabes unis

en.title: FlyDubai copilot who assaulted captain was planning a "terrorist act", says UAE prosecutor general
en.summary: The prosecutor general of the United Arab Emirates has stated that the copilot involved in an assault on a FlyDubai flight was planning a terrorist act.

stories.title: Vol Flydubai : le copilote à l’origine de l’attaque planifiait un «acte terroriste» et était interdit de vol par les autorités d’Oman

en.title: FlyDubai flight: copilot behind attack was planning a "terrorist act" and was banned from flying by Omani authorities
en.summary: The UAE prosecutor general announced that the copilot was preparing a terrorist act. Omani authorities had previously banned him from flying after he reportedly became radicalized during time in Syria.

stories.title: OPINION « Taux d'intérêt : les marchés sifflent la fin de la récréation », par Othman Nasrou, secrétaire général des Républicains et ancien ministre

en.title: OPINION "Interest rates: the markets signal the end of the holiday", by Othman Nasrou, secretary general of The Republicans and former minister
en.summary: A Republican party leader warns that rising French borrowing costs reflect growing debt concerns and calls for changing public spending policies to support work, production, and innovation.

stories.title: Près d'un sixième des réserves stratégiques de pétrole de l'AIE écoulées depuis mars

en.title: Nearly one-sixth of IEA strategic oil reserves released since March
en.summary: Approximately 325 million barrels of strategic oil reserves have been released from the 400 million barrels promised by the G7 in March, according to the International Energy Agency.

stories.title: Aux États-Unis, Bayer prends du poids avec un investissement de 2,2 milliards de dollars

en.title: In the United States, Bayer increases presence with 2.2 billion dollar investment
en.summary: German pharmaceutical company Bayer announced a major investment in a U.S. production facility, aligning with the Trump administration's efforts to expand domestic drug manufacturing.

stories.title: Boeing 737 MAX : le bug informatique jugé sans risque, le MAX 10 en passe d’être enfin certifié

en.title: Boeing 737 MAX: software bug deemed risk-free, MAX 10 set to finally be certified
en.summary: U.S. aviation regulators determined that a software bug found on certain Boeing 737 MAX aircraft poses no safety concern, clearing the way for certification of the MAX 10 variant.

stories.title: « Mon père est inégalable » : Le Petit Nicolas fait sa rentrée sous la plume de la fille Goscinny

en.title: "My father is unmatched": Little Nicholas returns to school under the pen of Goscinny's daughter
en.summary: The popular French schoolboy character and his friends return to school, with Anne Goscinny, daughter of the character's creator, sharing an exclusive drawing for the publication.
